title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: Digital Card Library
native_title: 新世紀エヴァンゲリオン デジタル・カード・ライブラリ
overview:
Kensuke: "Whoa, so this is the 'moving trading cards' everyone's talking about!"

Shinji: "Whoa!"

Asuka: "You two are actually interested in this stuff? How stupid."

Toji: "Mmph, mmph..."

Hikari: "Suzuhara, you're not supposed to buy snacks on the way home from school."

Rei: "..."

A digital trading card collection based on the Neon Genesis Evangelion anime series. Clear minigames and quizzes to add new cards to your library, then browse them to view artwork, clips from the show and comics drawn by the staff. Your collection is saved to memory backup.

ケンスケ「おおっ、これが噂の“動くトレーディングカード”かぁ！」

アスカ「あんたたちこんなのにキョーミあるわけ？　バッカみたいっ」

トウジ「ング、ング・・・・・。」

ヒカリ「スズハラ、下校中に買い喰いしちゃだめでしょ」

レイ「・・・・・・・・・。」
